programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Rains Down
programme.desc: Restaurant worker Sharon Coleman is murdered in a hail of large caliber gunfire. Kenda must break through a web of lies to hunt down one of the most dangerous criminal masterminds he’s ever faced.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Follow the Money
programme.desc: The body of a 72-year-old man is found in a junkyard, stabbed 13 times and wearing nothing but his underwear and dentures.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: After School Special
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when a beloved teacher is poisoned in her classroom. As doctors fight to save Barbara Lewis’ life, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team delve into her personal affairs.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Who Took Heather?
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl is missing, sending Kenda’s city into a panic. A cryptic letter to the District Attorney’s office suggests the girl isn’t the only victim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Raise the Dead
programme.desc: When a tip comes in suggesting a foul play on a 71yr old man, Lt. Joe Kenda is left with only one way to reveal the truth: exhume the body from its grave.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: 72 Hours: Bull's Eye
programme.desc: A Girl Guide leader is found dead on the floor of her bedroom. When an autopsy reveals a bullet lodged in her brain, detectives learn they’re investigating a murder.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This episode of Unplugged features Canadian star Alanis Morissette, shot from the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: The Roast of Flavor Flav
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er Flavor Flavs tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Another Period: Servant's Disease
programme.desc: En smitsom sygdom spredes blandt tjenestefolkene, og Lilian ender i karantæne med de syge. Beatrice og Frederick går på dobbeltdate, og Victor og Albert skændes over deres barbershop quartet.

programme.title: Another Period: Harvard
programme.desc: Albert Einstein besøger Ballacourt Manor, og Beatrice hjælper ham med at løse en svær ligning. Lillian prøver at skaffe et kondom, så hun kan have sex for nydelse, og Peepers finder Blanches 'fyr' på tosseanstalten.

programme.title: Another Period: Joplin
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice prøver at skrive et hit med hjælp fra en Kanye-agtig sangskriver ved navn Joplin. Peepers kæmper med sine nyligt opdagede kødelige lyster.

programme.title: Another Period: Tubman
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice møder Harriet Tubman, der fortæller dem, hvordan de skaber et 'brand' til sig selv og bliver berømte. Imens ansætter Peepers en ny tjener, og Chair føder baby Kermit.

programme.title: Workaholics: Checkpoint Gnarly
programme.desc: Alices bror kommer på forretningsrejse. Anders, Adam og Blake tager ham ud i byen en aften. Det går galt, når de bliver tjekket for sprutkørsel.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake beslutter, at de vil have en fridag for at fejre helligdagen 'halvt jul'. Når Alice nægter, strejker de.

programme.title: Workaholics: Muscle I'd Like to Flex
programme.desc: Fyrene øver sig på deres troldmands-rap til renæssaincemarkedet. Adam falder for en ældre kvinde, som han møder, mens han træner på kontorets tag. Anders og Blake føler sig uden for.

programme.title: Workaholics: In the Line of Getting Fired
programme.desc: Adam, Anders og Blake må kæmpe for deres job, når TelAmeriCorps direktør, Bruce Benson, beslutter at likvidere firmaet. Benson har en meget mærkelig anmodning.

programme.title: iCarly: Nærmest uudholdeligt
programme.desc: Mrs. Benson opdager Sam og Freddies forhold efter Gibby, som Sam nu håner, og planlægger at skille dem ad. Vil Carly kæmpe for Sam og Freddie, eller hjælpe Gibby med at skille dem ad?

programme.title: iCarly: Fuld af kærlighed
programme.desc: Carly siger, at Sam og Freddie skal prøve hinandens yndlingshobbier. Imens møder Spencer en gammel barnepige og inviterer hende ud på middag. Men bliver de sammen, efter de falder tilbage i deres gamle roller?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved at prøve at se smartere ud, end hun er. Og slænget prøver at finde et nyt sted at bo til T-Bo, efter han bliver smidt ud af Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynder at undersøge iCarly-slænget, efter de hacker ind i et sikkert netværk for at holde netfødselsdag for Carlys far. *Gæstestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Fedtekage-tyv
programme.desc: Slænget, minus Carly, tager Sam med til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men så kan Sam ikke komme ind i Amerika igen. Imens har Carly problemer i badet, mens hun gør sig klar til en date.

programme.title: iCarly: En øjenåbner
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet affærdiget i et interview om iCarly, prøver Freddie at vise sin kreative side ved at webcaste iCarly i 3D. Spencer hyrer en assistent, som han ikke har råd til at betale.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere 2
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren, der spiller Rex on Victorious, vender tilbage som vært i et dybdeborende interview med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres vildt sjove bloopers/fraklip. *Gæstestjerne: Rex fra Victorious.

programme.title: iCarly: Stadig en galning
programme.desc: Efter at have fået besked om, at Nora Dershlit bliver løsladt fra fængslet, ser iCarly-slænget, hvad de kan gøre for at holde hende bag tremmer. Imens opdager mrs. Benson den rigtige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly får britisk besøg
programme.desc: Carly får en smitsom sygdom og kommer til at smitte et medlem fra band One Direction. Imens skal Spencer træne en lille pige, der ikke kan fordrage at motionere.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolerestauranten
programme.desc: Gibby åbner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kælder med Sams hjælp. Og Spencer designer en vagtrobot til loftet, der mod al forventning går grassat.
